Cost: 2 Investiture

One crack fractures. All cracks shatter.

Spend 2 Investiture and test Blue vs. Cognitive. On success, remove all your Omens within Attunement Range simultaneously; each enemy whose Omen is removed takes [Tier][Die] spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of your next turn.

Cost: 3 Investiture

When the pattern breaks, everything breaks with it.

Spend 3 Investiture. Place an Omen on every enemy in Attunement Range up to your cap (prioritize as you choose), then remove all your Omens simultaneously — each removed Omen deals [Tier][Die] + Awareness spirit damage and Disorients its bearer until the start of your next turn. Enemies that are Isolated when their Omen is removed instead take 2[Tier][Die] vital damage.
